description:
What is This Part?
These are the King Pins for the Knuckle/Axle.
These will fit the top and bottom of either side (LH & RH).
Direct Replacement
King Pins may require minor sanding to fit the bearing
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – King Pins (1 side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
